original_protocol.reward: new achievement +1; death -1; inherent 3000-action deadline has zero future value
original_protocol.comparison: Fresh 16M-ending schedules for all 30 runs; final validation means primary; 4M checkpoints secondary. Paired RNG seeds, not identical rollout data.
original_protocol.v5_changes: Object footprints, corresponding placement/interaction/light/worldgen/UI corrections only. No recipe/resource/tool/observation changes.
original_protocol.selection: After all runs: method with highest mean final validation score across both versions and all five seeds; tie lower mean death then name. Paired seed with highest average final v4/v5 score within that method; tie lower mean death then seed. Freeze both final policies before testing.
original_protocol.test_rule: Same new 128 world IDs once PER VERSION for the two frozen paired policies. Separate exclusive claim files; ambiguous/crashed tests never retried. No tuning against tests.

learning_gate.rule: Report five-seed paired 95% Student-t intervals. Non-inferiority supported only if lower score bound >= -1 and upper death-difference bound <= .05 in every package. Otherwise inconclusive or negative, not automatic promotion. Report furnace/anvil rates separately; do not hide regressions behind aggregate score.

original_protocol.initialization: No policy warm starts; no transfer of v4 weights to v5.
original_protocol.promotion: None automatic. Main checkout stays v4; versioned preview/experiment artifacts preserved.

budget_amendment.reserved_test_policy: Do not perform official selection or consume reserved test worlds for a truncated study.
budget_amendment.stop_method: External PID-validated deadline controller sends SIGTERM to the frozen supervisor, preserves checkpoints/curves and writes a partial report. Any KeyboardInterrupt in runner status at this event is an intentional user stop, not an unexplained training failure.
